maml:description.maml:para: Retrieves properties on connected docks

This command retrieves properties on connected docks. The following properties are only supported on select docks: WLANCapability, WifiSSID, WifiPasswordSet, Bluetooth, QuickConnect, QuickConnectProximity, LEDBaseLight, and LEDPowerLight. If a property is supported for the current dock but retrieved null or empty value, please try updating to the latest dock firmware and latest version of the HP Dock WMI Provider.
If specified, run Install-HPDockWmiProvider first to ensure WMI Provider is installed.

Retrieves the latest firmware version available for the connected dock
This command retrieves the latest firmware version available for the connected dock. Please note that this command only supports one dock at a time.
Specifies the dock model to retrieve dock firmware update for instead of the currently connected dock.

If specified, the command will return $True if the currently installed firwmare version is the latest, and $False if not. Cannot be used wtih Download parameter. The command will error out if DockModel parameter specifies a dock that is not currently connected.
Specifies the dock model to retrieve dock firmware update for instead of the currently connected dock.

If specified, this command will download the dock firmware update SoftPaq to the current path specified by the -SaveAs parameter. Cannot be used with Check parameter. The command will overwrite the file if it already exists.

Specifies the location and/or file name for the downloaded dock firmware update SoftPaq. Can be a file name (e.g., 'update.exe'), a directory path (e.g., 'C:\Downloads\'), or a full file path (e.g., 'C:\Downloads\update.exe'). If file name is not specified, the remote file name will be used in the current directory.

If specified, the command installs WMI provider regardless if WMI provider is already installed and if so, regardless of the current version.

Sets properties on connected docks

This command sets properties on connected docks. Some properties are only supported on select docks: WLANCapability, WifiSSID, WifiPasswordSet, Bluetooth, QuickConnect, QuickConnectProximity, LEDBaseLight, and LEDPowerLight. If a property is supported for the current dock but unable to set the property, please try updating to the latest dock firmware and latest version of the HP Dock WMI Provider.

Sets admin password on connected dock
This command sets or changes the admin password on connected dock.
Allows the IT administrator to specify the new admin password for the dock to use. Please make sure the password is at least 6 characters long and not more than 32 characters long.

Allows the IT administrator to specify the current admin password for the dock if there is one set. If the dock currently has an admin password set and this parameter is not provided, the command will fail. Likewise, if a current password is provided but it is incorrect or there is no dock password set, the command will fail.

command:example.maml:title: -------------------------- Example 1 --------------------------
command:example.dev:code: PS C:\> $plainString = "mySecretPassword123" PS C:\> $secureString = ConvertTo-SecureString -String $plainString -AsPlainText -Force PS C:\> Set-HPDockAdminPassword -AdminPassword $secureString

maml:description.maml:para: Updates firmware on connected docks if available
This command updates firmware on connected docks if available.

If specified, run Install-HPDockWmiProvider first to ensure WMI Provider is installed. The HP Dock WMI Provider is only needed to query for connected dock information to find the corresponding dock firmware SoftPaq. Consequently, if File parameter is also specified, it will override this parameter as File parameter allows users to pass in a SoftPaq exe and is intended for offline and WAN protection scenarios.
If specified, the command updates the firmware immediately rather than staging the update onto the dock so that update occurs when dock is disconnected.
Specifies user interaction. Values are Silent, Interactive, Non-Interactive. If not specified, Silent mode is default.
If specified, the command updates all firmware components to be updated regardless of the current version.

Specifies the file path to a dock firmware update SoftPaq (sp#####.exe) to be used instead of querying and downloading the latest dock firmware update Softpaq. Must be a file path, not a directory. If a filename or relative path is provided, the current directory is assumed. The SoftPaq number is extracted from the filename for proper extraction.
